system_resolution: Joined against starmap.json by walking each location's ParentUUID chain up to its root Star node (Stanton/Pyro/Nyx). Falls back to a direct name-prefix match on RequiredLocations/AvailabilityLocations values, then to a Stanton/Pyro/Nyx substring match on DebugName/GeneratorClass as a last resort. resolution_method on each record says which path was used.
planet_moon_resolution: possible_planets_moons comes from AvailabilityLocations[].ResolvedLocations[].Name matched by name against data-layer/derived/location-gazetteer/gazetteer.json. This is WHERE THE MISSION IS AVAILABLE TO PICK UP (jurisdiction/broker-listing level), not the mission's actual objective/site - that finer site (e.g. a specific wreck or outpost room) is generated per-instance at runtime and does not exist as a static value in these files. Every record with this field carries the same caveat in its own 'note' field so it survives being read out of context.
